name: vaulter
description: Encrypted static build of my vault viewer

paragraphs: The browser app Jim reads the vault in, at It holds no notes: behind a password it reads them at runtime from the vault, the private repo JimLundin/vault, keeps them in plaintext on the device, and works offline. Chat and Agent use durable typed EAV records. Search still reads Wiki nodes; History reads accepted EAV and Node transactions. The Vault owns translation and enrichment tooling that targets the current Vaulter modules. Its source readers, extraction policy and private review data evolve in the Vault; Vaulter modules own their current record validation and historical reads. See Wiki…

requirements.text: Login-preloaded keys show their configured status.
Replace them, restore their login values, or clear optional keys with explicit actions; production credential overrides are encrypted on the device and removed by sign-out.
